## `cidx ssh-key`

Usage: `cidx ssh-key [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

```text
Manage SSH keys for private repository access.

Create, list, delete, and assign SSH keys for authenticating
with private Git repositories (GitHub, GitLab, etc.).

Available commands:
  create       - Generate new SSH key pair
  list         - List all managed and unmanaged keys
  delete       - Delete key and remove mappings
  show-public  - Display public key for copying
  assign       - Assign key to remote host
```

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`assign`](#cidx-ssh-key-assign) | Assign an SSH key to a remote host. |
| [`create`](#cidx-ssh-key-create) | Create a new SSH key pair. |
| [`delete`](#cidx-ssh-key-delete) | Delete an SSH key and its host mappings. |
| [`list`](#cidx-ssh-key-list) | List all SSH keys. |
| [`show-public`](#cidx-ssh-key-show-public) | Display the public key for copying. |

## `cidx ssh-key assign`

Usage: `cidx ssh-key assign [OPTIONS] NAME`

```text
Assign an SSH key to a remote host.

NAME is the name of the key to assign.
This updates ~/.ssh/config to use this key for the specified host.
```

| Argument | Type | Required |
|----------|------|----------|
| `NAME` | text | yes |

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|--------|------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `--host`, `-h` | text |  | yes | Hostname to assign (e.g., github.com) |
| `--force`, `-f` | flag |  | no | Override user section conflicts |

## `cidx ssh-key create`

Usage: `cidx ssh-key create [OPTIONS] NAME`

```text
Create a new SSH key pair.

NAME is the name for the key (used as filename in ~/.ssh/).
```

| Argument | Type | Required |
|----------|------|----------|
| `NAME` | text | yes |

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|--------|------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `--key-type`, `-t` | choice: `ed25519`, `rsa` | `ed25519` | no | Type of SSH key to generate (default: ed25519) |
| `--email`, `-e` | text |  | no | Email comment to include in the key |
| `--description`, `-d` | text |  | no | Human-readable description for the key |

## `cidx ssh-key delete`

Usage: `cidx ssh-key delete [OPTIONS] NAME`

```text
Delete an SSH key and its host mappings.

NAME is the name of the key to delete.
```

| Argument | Type | Required |
|----------|------|----------|
| `NAME` | text | yes |

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|--------|------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `--force`, `-f` | flag |  | no | Delete without confirmation |

## `cidx ssh-key list`

Usage: `cidx ssh-key list [OPTIONS]`

```text
List all SSH keys.

Shows both CIDX-managed keys and unmanaged keys found in ~/.ssh/.
```
